**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The Agreement contains no minimum purchase commitment or take-or-pay obligation on Bluefly:

- **§ 4.1 (Charges)** — fees are payable only for Services specified in Service Option Attachments/Order Forms, on a one-time, installment, recurring or usage basis. This is our preferred position: pay for ordered services or actual usage only.
- **§ 11.5 (Capacity Planning)** — allocates capacity-planning responsibility to Customer but sets no committed capacity, volume floor or usage cap.
- **§ 3.4 (Termination for Convenience)** — Customer may exit the Agreement or any individual Service Option Attachment on one month's notice, so even if a commitment were introduced there is a contractual exit.
- Text searches for "minimum", "commit", "shortfall", "take or pay" and "volume" surface nothing else relevant.

One diligence point noted rather than flagged: § 3.4(b) conditions convenience termination on "the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments." None appear in the reviewed text, but we should confirm the attachments carry no minimum-volume or shortfall charge before signature.
